sources.note: Spring Data help page; WebFetch extraction (paraphrase)

claims.statement: Every repository tied to an entity is collected in one place even across packages.
claims.supports: collects every repository tied to an entity in one place
claims.surfaceEquivalent: Headless on the Persistence view model: repositories of Customer, Product and Order, declared in another package than the entities, are grouped under each entity's Repositories node (RS-811). Not checked: tool window drawing and non-Spring repository styles.

claims.statement: Grouped repositories appear in a Repositories section where one can open an implementation or create a new repository.
claims.supports: Repositories section, open implementation or create new
claims.surfaceEquivalent: Headless on the Persistence view: Repositories group item menu creates a new repository (RS-812); opening a repository node is only checked as an accepted open-location call (RS-813). Not checked: an editor really opening, jump to an implementation class, tool window drawing.
